fixtures.env: Solo E0 Aglaea vs a dummy Elite (atk 150 so she survives 8 cycles; Lightning weakness, 600 Toughness), 8 cycles. energyStartFrac 1 makes the very first action the full-energy Ultimate 'Dance, Destined Weaveress' (140203): it summons Garmentmaker, enters Supreme Stance, starts the SPD-100 Supreme countdown and immediately performs the Joint ATK 'Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss' (140208). While Supreme Stance lasts (countdown 100 AV, Aglaea SPD 250 so she outruns it) every action is another Joint ATK; when the countdown hits, Garmentmaker self-destructs (+20 Energy via 'Bloom of Drying Grass'). Afterwards the rotation cycles Skill 'Rise, Exalted Renown' (140202; re-summon path grants an immediate extra action) and Basic 'Thorned Nectar' (140201; re-applies each attack), Garmentmaker occasionally acts alone with memosprite skill 'Thorned Snare' (1140201), and a second full Ultimate resets the Supreme countdown. Verifies E0 kits: no E1 energy trickle, no E2 DEF-ignore stacks, no E6 RES PEN.

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Thorned Nectar (140201, Thunder) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.

requirements.hint: Canon 140203 'Dance, Destined Weaveress': summons Garmentmaker, enters Supreme Stance and immediately takes action. Structure: the Ultimate must enter the stance and log it.
requirements.claim: Engine: Ultimate activates at full Energy (350), sets its own cost to 0 and logs entering the stance.

of.log: Aglaea Ultimate: Supreme Stance \(Joint ATK, countdown SPD 100\)

requirements.hint: Canon 140203: Supreme Stance runs on a countdown (Ult #4: SPD 100). Structure: entering the stance registers the countdown timer.
requirements.claim: Engine: the memosprite countdown timer 'Supreme Countdown' (SPD 100) is registered at Ultimate time and logged.

requirements.hint: Canon 140208 'Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss': Aglaea and Garmentmaker launch a Joint ATK (Blast). Structure: Supreme Stance actions are Joint ATKs, not ordinary Basics.
requirements.claim: Engine: the immediate action after the Ultimate and every Supreme action hits with the 'Joint ATK (main)' attack.

requirements.hint: Canon 140204 'Rosy-Fingered': memosprite Garmentmaker has SPD = #4 of Aglaea SPD and Max HP = #5 of Aglaea Max HP + #6. Structure: the summon is created with mirrored stats.
requirements.claim: Engine: the Ultimate summons the SPD/HP-mirrored Garmentmaker and logs its live SPD and HP.

requirements.hint: Canon 140201 'Thorned Nectar': Basic deals Lightning DMG to one designated enemy. Structure: the normal (non-Supreme) Basic keeps its own identity.
requirements.claim: Engine: after the first Supreme Stance ends, the plain Basic hits with the 'Thorned Nectar' attack.

requirements.hint: Canon 140204: while Garmentmaker is on the field Aglaea's attacks inflict 'Seam Stitch'. Structure: the debuff object is applied to the target.
requirements.claim: Engine: attacks on the target apply the 'Seam Stitch DMG Taken+' buff with infinite duration. E0 follows canon: NO DMG-taken increase yet (mods empty at Eidolon 0).

requirements.hint: Canon 140202 'Rise, Exalted Renown': restores HP to Garmentmaker by #1 of its Max HP. Parameters: the heal amount is a % of Garmentmaker's Max HP.
requirements.claim: Engine: the Skill heals Garmentmaker and logs the actual amount.

requirements.hint: Canon memosprite 1140201 'Thorned Snare': Garmentmaker's own Blast. Parameters: the memosprite action carries its own ability identity.
requirements.claim: Engine: on Garmentmaker's own turn it attacks with the 'Thorned Snare' (main) / 'Thorned Snare (adj)' Blast.

requirements.hint: Canon 1140206 'Bloom of Drying Grass': when Garmentmaker disappears, Aglaea regenerates Energy. Parameters: Supreme Stance teardown fires the disappearance event.
requirements.claim: Engine: when the countdown fires, the memosprite disappears and the stance end is logged.

of.log: Aglaea Supreme Stance ends; Garmentmaker vanished \(SPD was \d+\)

requirements.hint: Canon: Energy-rich kit — a second full Ultimate must be reachable during the battle. Parameters: the Ultimate cost is 350 and every recharge path yields exactly sp_base Energy.
requirements.claim: Engine: the second full-Energy Ultimate fires the same stance entry (countdown resets via re-registration).

of.log: Aglaea Ultimate: Supreme Stance \(Joint ATK, countdown SPD 100\)

requirements.hint: Canon 140203: the stance entry grants an immediate action. Ordering: the Joint ATK must follow the Ult that granted it.
requirements.claim: Engine: the first 'Joint ATK (main)' hit comes after the first Supreme Stance Ultimate note.

before.log: Aglaea Ultimate: Supreme Stance \(Joint ATK, countdown SPD 100\)

requirements.hint: Canon 140203: entering Supreme Stance starts the countdown. Ordering: the countdown registration happens during the Ultimate's own perform block (the engine logs the stance entry right after the countdown line).
requirements.claim: Engine: summoning the countdown and logging its start happen as part of the Ultimate; the stance-entry note lands immediately after.

after.log: Aglaea Ultimate: Supreme Stance \(Joint ATK, countdown SPD 100\)

requirements.hint: Canon 140202: if Garmentmaker is absent the Skill summons it and makes this unit immediately take action. Ordering: the immediate-action grant is logged after the restore (absent-path only).
requirements.claim: Engine: after the first Supreme Stance teardown, Skill re-summon logs the heal first, then the immediate-action grant.

after.log: Aglaea Skill: GM summoned — immediate action

requirements.hint: Canon 140204 Talent: attacking the Seam-Stitched enemy adds Lightning Additional DMG on top. Interactions: the talent fires the extra hit against the marked target only.
requirements.claim: Engine: attacking the stitched Elite resolves the Talent's extra 'Seam Stitch' Lightning hit.

requirements.hint: Canon trace 'The Myopic's Doom': in Supreme Stance Aglaea & Garmentmaker get ATK up by 720% of Aglaea SPD + 360% of Garmentmaker SPD. Interactions: the stance grants a real flat-ATK stat effect for both.
requirements.claim: Engine: while Supreme, Aglaea holds the ATK-flat buff (SPD 250 gives 7.2 x 250 = 1800 plus the Garmentmaker term).

requirements.hint: Canon E6 'Fluctuate in the Tapestry of Fates': 20% Lightning RES PEN is an Eidolon-6 effect. Interactions: an E0 run must NOT apply it.
requirements.claim: Engine: E0 never grants the E6 RES PEN buff.
